Title: Improving extreme Fire Radiative Power forecasting with Gaussian loss-based transformer and LSTM models
Authors / PI: Ziheng Sun; Yunyao Li; Li Zhang; Daniel Tong; Shan Sun; Gonzalo Ferrada; Wei-Ting Hung; Hui Fang; Jiaxin Ding
Brief Abstract: The study evaluates a Gaussian-weighted Huber loss for forecasting extreme fire radiative power from satellite observations and environmental predictors. It compares transformer and long short-term memory models using data from 2017–2020 across California, the Congo Basin, East African savanna, and Mato Grosso, Brazil. Gaussian weighting reduced underprediction and improved some transformer forecasts of intense fires, while LSTM results varied across regions. The adjustment also introduced localized overprediction, highlighting a trade-off between correcting systematic underestimation and maintaining prediction stability.
